experiment: P3o-C parameter-matched delay and local time-frequency complementarity
motivation: P3o-B found a strong local time-frequency baseline but its dual-view model had materially fewer parameters. P3o-C tests whether a delay sequence adds complementary low-power information after parameter matching, not whether another contrast weight can be tuned.

D_delay_matched.view: normalized complex autocorrelation lags 1..1024 plus fixed 7/31 smoothing

F_time_frequency_matched.view: STFT n_fft=128 hop=64 log magnitude plus adjacent-frame phase increment

DF_dual_matched.view: fixed delay and local time-frequency branches fused before a common 64-dimensional multitask head

parameter_match_rule: Every model must be within 5 percent of F_time_frequency_matched parameters before training. Parameter matching is verified and saved before opening development outputs.

training.parameter_loss: 0.1 * masked SmoothL1 over label=1 AND parameter_mask=1 AND finite(target)

selection_and_safety.checkpoint: C_joint: maximum early macro-AUPR among epochs with early oracle parameter macro-NMAE <= 1.01 times early minimum
selection_and_safety.threshold: F1 per class on calibration; replace only ISRJ threshold by lowest threshold with every regime x power calibration cell one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson FPR upper <=0.10

failure_rule: If DF does not pass every gate, do not alter widths, representation, thresholds, checkpoint, learning rate, epochs, or seed1040000000. The conclusion must distinguish a fair negative result (delay adds no complementary value) from a residual low-power representational limitation.
